skills.name: Lady's Bat
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When Lucy uses her fourth Basic Attack, the currently on-field guard boars will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

skills.name: To Arms!
skills.desc: In combat, the guard boars will randomly use a baseball bat, boxing gloves, or a slingshot to automatically attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Spinning Swing!
skills.desc:
When Lucy uses the fourth Basic Attack, or when she gains the Cheer On! status, the guard boars will whirl their baseball bats in a continuous motion, dealing Physical DMG to nearby enemies.
If the attack cannot be executed immediately, the guard boars will remember the required number of times to execute it.

skills.name: Foul Ball!
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Fearless Boar!
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Returning Tusk!
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Hit By Pitch!
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG. Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: Safe on Base!
skills.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Scored a Run!
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Solid Hit!
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing Fire DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: Home Run!
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Cheer On!
skills.desc: After using EX Special Attack, when a guard boar triggers an explosion, it will apply the Cheer On! status to all allies, Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves. While under the Cheer On! status, allies' ATK increases by 13.8% of Lucy's ATK + 44, up to a maximum of 600. The Cheer On! status lasts for 10s when a Line Drive is hit, and 15s when a Fly Ball is hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: Grand Slam!
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: Walk-Off Home Run!
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: Crimson Mane Guard
skills.desc: When Lucy uses her Special Attack or EX Special Attack, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK and Impact. The Cheer On! buff for the guard boars is increased to 140% of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

skills.name: Batter Up!
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
The guard boars inherit Lucy's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

cons.name: Drill Formations
cons.desc: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.

cons.name: Little Boar Captain
cons.desc: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members, Bangboo, and the guard boars the Cheer On! status for 10s.

cons.name: Ironfist Overseer
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Chaos Ball Game
cons.desc: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.

cons.name: Wildland Princess
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Fierce Fangs of Fire
cons.desc: When an ally in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an EX Special Attack, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Fire DMG equal to 300% of the guard boar’s ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar’s explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.

能量自动回复、攻击力百分比
